messages.content: 你能幫我找到加州洛杉磯的素食餐廳嗎？它們至少要營業到晚上10點，然後也幫我找一下加州舊金山和華盛頓州西雅圖的素食餐廳嗎？

function.name: vegan_restaurant_find_nearby
function.description: Locate nearby vegan restaurants based on specific criteria like operating hours. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. New York, NY

operating_hours.description: Preferred latest closing time of the restaurant. E.g. if 11 is given, then restaurants that close at or after 11 PM will be considered. This is in 24 hour format.

message.reasoning: The user wants vegan restaurants in Los Angeles, California (must close at or after 10 PM), also in San Francisco, CA, and Seattle, WA. They want to find them. We have a function vegan_restaurant_find_nearby that takes location and operating_hours. The user wants multiple locations. We can call the function twice: once for Los Angeles with operating_hours=22, once for San Francisco with operating_hours=22, and once for Seattle with operating_hours=22. But the function only accepts one location at a time. We can call it three times. The user didn't specify a default for operating_hours, but we can pass 22. The function returns any. We'll call it for each location. Then we can provide the results. The user didn't ask for anything else. So we should call the function for each location.
